fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: BANK CODE
fields.description: Bank clearing code of the reporting bank as issued by Kenya Banker's Association (KBA).

fields.name: BRANCH ID
fields.description: Branch code where the transaction took place

fields.name: CUSTOMER CATEGORY
fields.description: Whether the customer is a regular bank client or a 'walk-in' customer

fields.name: CUSTOMER PTY ID
fields.description: Unique customer identifier as assigned to customers by the reporting institution.

fields.name: IDENTIFICATION DOCUMENT NUMBER
fields.description: Customer identification number such as National ID,Passport or alien number

fields.name: CUSTOMER NAME
fields.description: Transacting customer names as per the identification documents

fields.name: TIME AND DATE OF TRADING
fields.description: Date and time of trading: Format {YYYYMMDD HH:MM:SS} as per ISO 8601.

fields.name: START DATE
fields.description: Date and time of trading: Format {DD-MON-YYYY HH:MM:SS} as per ISO 8601.

fields.name: MATURITY DATE
fields.description: Date and time of trading: Format {DD-MON-YYYY HH:MM:SS} as per ISO 8601.

fields.name: TRANSACTION REFERENCE NO
fields.description: Unique number reference for the transaction

fields.name: TRANSACTION TYPE
fields.description: The type of forex transaction

fields.name: CURRENCY QUOTED
fields.description: ISO currency code of the currency Quoted as per ISO- 4217. {e.g. USD, GPB, EUR, KES. etc.}

fields.name: CURRENCY TRADED
fields.description: ISO currency code of the currency traded as per ISO- 4217. {e.g. USD, GPB, EUR, KES. etc.}

fields.name: EXCHANGE RATE TYPE
fields.description: The exchange rate category marked in the system. E.g. SPOT, FORWARD, SWAP, etc

fields.name: SPOT RATE
fields.description: The exchange rate for the transaction.

fields.name: NEAR LEG RATE
fields.description: The near exchange rate for the swap transaction

fields.name: FAR LEG RATE
fields.description: The far or forward exchange rate for the swap / forward contract transaction

fields.name: CROSS RATE APPLIED
fields.description: The rate applied either a Buy or Sell

fields.name: AMOUNT IN QUOTED CURRENCY
fields.description: Amount in the currency quoted

fields.name: AMOUNT IN TRADED CURRENCY
fields.description: Amount in transaction currency

fields.name: AMOUNT IN LOCAL CURRENCY EQUIV
fields.description: Amount in Kenyan currency (KES)

fields.name: USD EQUIVALENT
fields.description: Amount in USD

fields.name: SPECIFIC SOURCE OF FUNDS DESC
fields.description: The purpose for the trade

fields.name: SECTOR CODE
fields.description: Code assigned to the particular trade. {e.g. K1, N1, K2, N2. etc}

fields.name: ECONOMIC SECTOR CODE
fields.description: The sector code as per the System of National Accounts (SNA) 2008.

fields.name: BUSINESS ECONOMIC ACT CODE
fields.description: The economic activity related to the transaction as per (International Standard Industrial Classification of Economic Activities (ISIC).

fields.name: CUST BUSINESS ECONOMIC SEG
fields.description: e.g. Corporate, Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Personal and Parastatal.
